page.overview:
Who is Abner Jenkins?

As the Beetle, Abner is one of the many villains that teamed with Doctor Doom in his mission to use the remains of Silver Surfer's surfboard, to create a weapon.

Abner was one of several villains controlled by Loki through the nornfrost. He participated in the escape in the Helicarrier, until he was later arrested.

Abner was asked to join the Thunderbolts by Helmut Zemo, using the identity of Mach-V. After spending time in the group pretending to be a hero, Abner decided to become one in fact.
